description: D1: he fills his chest, the head drawn back (1.45 s), and breathes the cold out over the ground ahead: a cone of 40 m and 34 degrees from his feet swept 46 degrees across his front (his right to his left) for 1.3 s, a pulse every 0.2 s (hit shape titan_breath: every pulse strikes). Little damage; each pulse rimes the giant heavily - stand in it and he freezes. Blocking halves it; stepping out of the sweep or round behind him escapes it.
